o: the instruction to withhold food and drink for a set period before anaesthesia to protect the airway
lying the unconscious patient on the side with the head turned so that vomit drains out
the patient's voluntary agreement to a procedure after its nature, risks and alternatives are explained
the timed washing of hands and forearms with an antiseptic solution before gowning
items.s: Surgical scrub: the timed washing of hands and forearms with an antiseptic solution before gowning. The other options describe Informed consent, Recovery position, Nil by mouth.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Incentive spirometer.
o: blocking of the passage for air, recognised by noisy breathing and use of accessory muscles
a hand-held device that encourages slow breaths to keep the lung bases expanded
positioning the body so that gravity helps secretions leave a particular lung segment
breathlessness that comes on when lying flat and is relieved by sitting upright
items.s: Incentive spirometer: a hand-held device that encourages slow breaths to keep the lung bases expanded. The other options describe Airway obstruction, Orthopnoea, Postural drainage.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “a sugar level above the normal band, causing thirst, passing much water and drowsiness”
o: Hypoglycaemia
Glycaemic control
Capillary blood glucose
Hyperglycaemia
items.s: Hyperglycaemia is a sugar level above the normal band, causing thirst, passing much water and drowsiness.

items.q: In this course, Dehydration refers to
o: loss of body water greater than the intake, shown by thirst, dry mouth and poor skin turgor
a sodium level below the normal band, causing confusion, headache and muscle twitching
the water outside the cells, including plasma and the liquid between tissues
the water inside the body's cells, richest in potassium and phosphate
items.s: Dehydration: loss of body water greater than the intake, shown by thirst, dry mouth and poor skin turgor. The other options describe Intracellular fluid, Hyponatraemia, Extracellular fluid.

items.q: “a tracing of the heart's electrical activity taken from electrodes on the skin” is the definition of
o: Myocardial infarction
Deep vein thrombosis
Central venous pressure
Electrocardiogram
items.s: Electrocardiogram is a tracing of the heart's electrical activity taken from electrodes on the skin.

items.q: Isometric exercise may be defined as
o: a fixed shortening of muscle or tendon that limits movement of the joint
walking with or without support, a goal resumed gradually after illness or surgery
dangerous tension inside a closed tissue space that cuts off its supply
tightening a muscle without shortening it, which builds strength without joint movement
items.s: Isometric exercise: tightening a muscle without shortening it, which builds strength without joint movement. The other options describe Ambulation, Compartment syndrome, Contracture.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “lying the unconscious patient on the side with the head turned so that vomit drains out”
o: Informed consent
Sterile field
Recovery position
Surgical scrub
